type Holder struct
  Program string
  Account string
  Amount int64
  Evidence Evidence
  Lease string
  Grant string
  Since string
  Detail string
type ResourceState struct
  Resource string
  Capacity int64
  Held int64
  Holders []Holder
  Observed string
  Instrument string
type HoldersResult struct
  Outcome ResourceCallOutcome
  State *ResourceState
type ResourceList struct
  Resources []string
  Observed string
type ResourcesResult struct
  Outcome ResourceCallOutcome
  List *ResourceList
type Lease struct
  ID string
  Resource string
  Amount int64
  Since string
  RenewBy string
type YieldRecord struct
  Holder string
  Amount int64
  Answer string
  TookMs int64
type AcquireResult struct
  Outcome AcquireOutcome
  Lease *Lease
  Asked []YieldRecord
type AcquireFreeResult struct
  Outcome AcquireFreeOutcome
  Lease *Lease
  Asked []YieldRecord
type YieldRequest struct
  ID string
  Resource string
  Amount int64
  Reason string
  At string
  Lease string
type YieldPage struct
  Requests []YieldRequest
  Next string
type ObserveResult struct
  Outcome ResourceCallOutcome
  Page *YieldPage
type AnswerResult struct
  Recorded bool
type AnswerCallResult struct
  Outcome ResourceCallOutcome
  Answer *AnswerResult
type LeaseChange struct
  Applied bool
  Lease *Lease
type LeaseChangeResult struct
  Outcome ResourceCallOutcome
  Change *LeaseChange
type ProcessBindResult struct
  Outcome ProcessBindOutcome
type EndpointRefusalDetail struct
  Source EndpointRefusalSource
  Decision EndpointRefusalDecision
  Ask EndpointRefusalAsk
  Action string
  Question string
  Credential string
  RetryAfterMs int64
type EndpointProducerCheck struct
  Kind string
  Copy string
  State EndpointProducerCheckState
  Reason string
  Checked string
type EndpointServiceState struct
  Service string
  Readiness EndpointServiceReadiness
  Reason string
  Guarantees []string
  Capabilities map[string]string
  DefinitionHash string
type EndpointDescription struct
  Outcome EndpointDescriptionOutcome
  Program string
  Version string
  Services []EndpointServiceState
  Refusal *EndpointRefusalDetail
  Reason string
  Checks []EndpointProducerCheck
type EndpointDescriptionResult struct
  Value EndpointDescription

type Leases interface
  AcquireFor(subject oaImported0, resource string, amount, waitMs int64) (AcquireResult, error)
  Acquire(resource string, amount, waitMs int64) (AcquireResult, error)
  AcquireFree(resource string, amount int64) (AcquireFreeResult, error)
  Renew(lease string) (LeaseChangeResult, error)
  Release(lease string) (LeaseChangeResult, error)
  Observe(cursor string, waitMs int64) (ObserveResult, error)
  Answer(request string, answer YieldAnswer, reason string) (AnswerCallResult, error)
  BindProcess(lease string, pid int64) (ProcessBindResult, error)
  Label(lease, text string) (LeaseChangeResult, error)
